assumptions: primary robustness sweep excludes fundamental discriminants -3 and -4
composite control is restricted to distinct prime factors of a squarefree conductor quotient
repeated-prime control uses explicit ell^(r+1)-torsion lifts to evaluate the divided orientation
single-lift repeated-prime recovery accepts a lift only when its divided-orientation Weil pairing has exact order ell
basis-guided repeated-prime recovery tests all ell+1 projective lift classes from a sampled lift-torsion basis
algebraic-basis recovery uses Sage torsion equations to avoid scalar-normalized random basis tails
target curve E1 is public; the secret Sage edge is validation data only
large composite/horizontal Kani reconstruction is not implemented
